title: Plumbing
shortDescription: Licensed plumbing installation, repairs, maintenance and water system solutions for homes, businesses and commercial sites.
description: Specialised Plumbing Installation provides practical plumbing solutions across reticulated water systems, domestic irrigation, fixture repairs, refurbishments, onsite treatment plants, backflow devices and thermostatic mixing valves. We also complete in-ground stormwater and sewer works, along with above-ground sanitary plumbing for domestic housing, retail shops, offices and commercial establishments.

title: Fire Suppression
shortDescription: Wet fire suppression systems designed to help protect people, property, equipment and rural assets.
description: SPIAUS installs and maintains wet fire suppression systems for domestic, commercial, rural and agricultural applications. This includes in-ground fire hydrant systems, above-ground steel hydrant systems, hose reel systems and fire sprinkler systems. These systems are well suited to rural properties, machinery sheds, stables, feed storage sheds and other high-risk areas.

title: Gas LPG & Natural
shortDescription: Licensed gas fitting for LPG, natural gas systems, appliances, hot water systems and food outlets.
description: Gas systems and appliances must be handled by a licensed gas fitter. SPIAUS can assist with a range of gas installation and servicing requirements, including appliance changeovers, complete gas supply systems, hot water systems and gas services for food outlets and commercial environments.

title: Roofing, Gutters & Downpipes
shortDescription: Roof plumbing, guttering, downpipes and rainwater collection solutions for residential and commercial properties.
description: SPIAUS provides roof plumbing services including repairs and alterations to roofs, gutters and downpipes. We also supply and install rainwater collection tanks above or below ground, along with associated pumping systems where required.
